title: Building the AL Exploration Tool I Always Wanted
summary: A developer shares how they built a VS Code extension for exploring AL codebases visually, using GitHub Copilot to overcome the barrier to entry. The tool provides dependency diagrams, relationship maps, where-used analysis, and documentation generation to help developers understand complex Business Central solutions faster.
key_points: Visual dependency diagrams and object relationship maps help developers understand AL codebase structure at a glance
Where-used analysis identifies references and impacts throughout a project for refactoring and troubleshooting
GitHub Copilot reduced the time needed to learn the VS Code extension framework and made building the tool practical
The extension is released free to the community following the tradition of sharing knowledge in the Business Central developer community

quotes.text: Copilot dramatically reduced the amount of time spent staring at documentation trying to figure out where to begin.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how AI tools lower barriers to entry for developers wanting to build extensions they previously avoided due to complexity
